name: Lambda Geminorum
description: A naked-eye star 30.9 parsecs away, 2.8 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 56537: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.835 +/- 0.013 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 2.777 +/- 0.047

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 56537: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 2.111 +/- 0.01

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 56537: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 8007 +/- 77

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 56537: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 32.36 +/- 0.22 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 31 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 2.8 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.835 milliarcseconds, which gives 2.777 solar radii and 8,007 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 56537: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
